coverage: Ground the recommendation in publisher/maintenance facts; preserve old-but-current and valid reconstruction exceptions while excluding abandoned snapshots and mirrors. Do not invent source freshness.
Reuse the existing CLI for safe readiness enforcement and merging, including valid atomic rejection rather than an invented status-check algorithm.
Project health judgment belongs in one playbook; generic launcher code retains identity/delivery invariants and accepts different task kinds without mutation or hidden eligibility decisions.

Produce an authoritative current guide without contradictory obsolete rules; keep retrospective explanations separately. Deterministic rule routing is necessary but not sufficient: judge the actual Markdown for clear current instructions and meaningful historical context.
Resolve shared guidance from one owner and keep the real project exception local. Updating canonical delivery text must propagate to both roles without stale duplicate instructions.
Shared guidance stays project-neutral and uses configuration instead of a hardcoded runner. Preserve real project-specific instructions in the owning playbook without adding fallback infrastructure.

Fix rounding with an executable failing-before/passing-after regression and targeted validation. Ordered tool evidence must show actual focused test execution; do not infer it from a completion claim. Avoid repeated unrelated integration work.

Diagnose from actual read evidence while honoring the explicit no-intervention boundary. Do not conceal a mutation by restoring the original board afterward; the ordered trace must contain no move/relaunch/nudge action.

Separate execution errors from completed behavioral outcomes and report explicit denominators. The written comparison must acknowledge unmatched tasks/availability and avoid unsupported model, latency or cost claims.

Preserve explicitly intentional product copy and first-visit onboarding while removing actual redundancy. Returning users should keep functional controls without replaying the welcome. Do not replace product intent with a generic style checklist.

Use the provided native message APIs and supported parts end to end; preserve tool/custom data without retaining an invented parallel format or an unnecessary migration path. SDK source stays unchanged.
Keep implementation/framework naming out of product labels while preserving stable tool IDs and dispatch contracts. Use the authoritative product label map and a sensible unknown-tool label.

Research and use the supplied provider-swappable API instead of inventing vendor adapters. Both provider strings must reach the native SDK with unchanged input order and supported vector shape; no network layer is needed.
Carry the corrected acceptance target through the callable, its actual CLI output and persisted result, removing obsolete scheduled work.

Handle demonstrated source dirtiness at the ingestion boundary with explicit accounting. Exact duplicates are different from conflicting identities or missing pages; preserve those real error checks and caller data. Use a meaningful regression.

Use the native dependency engine for the actual assets, not a single asset wrapping the old loop. Observe ordering, selective fresh-input updates, and preservation/resume of successful work across a branch failure. Do not claim cloud deployment or parallel execution from this local DAG fixture.
